title: 第54章尽仇定计釜底抽薪第53章再游羌部联势抗叛
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：藏龙覆虎魏阙寒烟第54章尽仇定计，釜底抽薪（..la）西羌之地，暮云垂野，黄沙漫卷三千里。
时值深秋，祁连山脉余脉延绵起伏，草木枯疏，朔风昼夜不息地刮过戈壁荒滩，卷起细碎沙砾，打在羌寨的土垒碉楼上，发出簌簌的轻响。天地间一派苍茫萧瑟，无半分中原秋景的温润雅致，唯有蛮荒旷野的凛冽与肃杀。
白水羌最大的聚落落龙寨中，篝火残烬未熄，袅袅青烟被狂风扯得支离破碎。寨中随处可见披发左衽的羌人勇士，腰悬短刀、背负硬弓，神色剽悍桀骜，眼底藏着常年征战游牧的野性与戾气。寨心最高的碉楼之内，灯火孤明，一室沉寂，与寨外的喧嚣粗野截然不同。
陈近仇端坐于粗毡铺就的石榻之上，一身素色长衫早已被塞外风沙磨得发旧，边角磨损，染满尘沙，却依旧身姿挺拔、风骨凛然。他眉眼清俊，却无半分温润柔和，眉宇间凝着经年不散的沉郁冷冽，一双黑眸深邃如寒潭，不见半点波澜，唯有深处藏着彻骨的恨意与筹谋已久的锋芒。
案上一盏油灯摇曳跳动，昏黄光影忽明忽暗，将他的影子投在斑驳的土墙上，孤峭如崖边寒松，孑然独立。桌上无酒无肉，唯有一卷泛黄的舆图平铺展开，图上密密麻麻标注着西羌各部属地、山川隘口、草场水源，更用墨笔圈出了几处关键据点，笔锋凌厉，力道千钧，每一处墨迹都藏着缜密心思。
此地距离中原万里之遥，关山阻隔、音讯断绝，是世人眼中的蛮荒绝域，却是陈近仇蛰伏三载、蓄势待发的棋局之地。
三年前，中原朝堂风起云涌，权奸当道、构陷忠良。陈氏一族世代忠良，镇守西疆数十载，戍边卫国、安抚羌民，从未有过半分逾矩。奈何朝堂奸佞忌惮陈家兵权赫赫、声望日隆，更视边疆重臣为夺权障碍，便罗织通敌叛国的莫须有罪名，一夜之间，抄家灭族。
满门百余口，老弱妇孺、忠臣义士，尽数血染刑场，尸骨无存。唯有彼时随父驻守西疆隘口的陈近仇，侥幸被亲卫拼死护送，于乱军之中突围逃生，自此沦落西羌，成了无国无家、孤悬塞外的亡命之人。
三年流离，三年隐忍。昔日少年将军的意气风发、赤诚热烈，早已被塞外的风霜、灭门的血海深仇尽数磨去。余下的，只有彻骨寒凉的恨意，以及卧薪尝胆、伺机复仇的决绝。
旁人皆道陈近仇苟且偷生、畏缩避世，唯有他自己清楚，他从未有一刻忘却满门血债。隐忍非怯懦，蛰伏非沉沦，他身在西羌蛮荒，心牵中原恨事，日夜筹谋，只为一朝风起，颠覆仇局，告慰满门忠魂。
“将军，夜风骤紧，寒意侵骨，该添些灯火了。”
门外传来低沉轻缓的脚步声，一名身着羌人布衣、形貌沉稳的男子推门而入，身姿恭谨，眼底满是敬畏。此人名为沈随，是当年拼死护送陈近仇突围的亲卫统领，三年来不离不弃、生死相随，是陈近仇身边唯一可信、可用的心腹之人。
沈随抬手拢了拢被风吹乱的衣襟，反手合上木门，隔绝了屋外呼啸的朔风与嘈杂的羌语喧哗。他目光落在案上的舆图上，看着那些密密麻麻的标注与圈点，轻声开口，语气中带着几分凝重：“各部信使已尽数归来，西羌目前局势，与将军推演的分毫不差。”
陈近仇闻言，缓缓抬眸，目光依旧沉静冷冽，无半分波澜，只淡淡出声，嗓音经三年风沙磨砺，低沉沙哑，带着一种穿透人心的力量：“逐一细说，不得疏漏。”
“是。”沈随躬身应下，缓步走到案前，垂首详述各部情势，“如今西羌八部，以黑水、白水、赤土三部最为强盛，其余五部皆附庸依附，势弱力微。黑水羌王慕野，性情暴戾贪婪，好大喜功，与中原奸相魏临私通已久，每年秋冬时节，必遣精锐骑兵越境劫掠边疆村落、抢夺粮秣人口，所得财物半数输送中原，供奉魏临，以此换取朝堂默许，甚至暗中的军械支援。”
“白水羌王妥罗，庸碌怯懦、胸无大志，只求固守草场、偏安一隅，无扩张争霸之心，常年依附黑水羌，随其进退，不敢有半分违逆。赤土羌王烈戈，勇猛善战、野心勃勃，不甘屈居人下，暗中积蓄兵力、收拢小部，与黑水羌积怨日久，只是忌惮黑水羌得魏临暗中相助，兵力强盛，故而一直隐忍不发，两相对峙，勉强维持平衡。”
沈随条理清晰，将西羌三部的势力纠葛、人心向背、利害关联尽数道来，字字精准，句句贴合实情。末了，他抬眸望向陈近仇，语气添了几分沉肃：“魏临之所以常年纵容、暗中扶持黑水羌，并非仅仅贪图财物供奉。其真正心思，是借西羌之乱牵制中原边疆兵力，耗损朝廷戍边军力、粮草辎重，待边疆疲敝、兵力空虚之时，便可彻底掌控西疆兵权，内外勾结，稳固自身朝堂权位，为日后篡权铺路。”
这番局势剖析，精准戳中了中原权奸与西羌叛部勾结的核心要害，也正是陈氏一族当年被构陷灭门的根本缘由。昔日陈家镇守西疆，严防羌患、杜绝内外私通，死死挡住了魏临勾结外藩、操控边疆的野心，故而才被视为眼中钉、肉中刺，惨遭灭门惨祸。
陈近仇指尖轻轻抚过舆图上黑水羌王庭的位置，墨色的纹路冰凉刺骨，一如他此刻的心境。他眸底寒意渐浓，唇角勾起一抹极淡、却彻骨冰冷的弧度，缓缓开口：“魏临老谋深算，深知‘外患不息，内权不移’的道理。西羌之乱，便是他稳固权位的根基；黑水羌的强盛，便是他牵制边疆、操控局势的薪火。”
“世人复仇，皆思斩敌首、平仇寇，快意恩仇、一击毙命。可魏临盘踞朝堂多年，党羽遍布朝野、根基深厚，若只逞一时血气，贸然刺杀、强攻，非但无法报仇，反而会打草惊蛇，招致全盘覆灭。”

他缓缓抬手，指尖重重点在舆图之上，语气坚定，字字铿锵：“故此，此仇不可强攻，只可巧取。不退敌、不斩将，先断其根、先绝其源。魏临的根基在朝堂，助力在西羌，黑水羌便是他安插在边疆的一把利刃，是他乱疆固权的薪火。”
“薪火既绝，利刃自折。此计，便是釜底抽薪。”
寥寥数语，道破全盘谋划。三年蛰伏，三年观察，三年推演，陈近仇早已看透这场横跨中原与西羌的权谋棋局。寻常复仇，求的是直面杀伐、手刃仇敌；而他的复仇，求的是颠覆全局、连根拔除，让仇敌从根基处崩塌，身败名裂、全盘皆输。
沈随闻言，眼底骤然亮起精光，随即躬身行礼，心悦诚服：“将军神机妙算，此计堪称绝杀！断魏临外援，乱西羌全局，不费中原一兵一卒，便可倾覆仇寇根基，远比正面强攻更为稳妥、更为彻底！”
陈近仇微微摇头，神色依旧凝重，无半分自得之意：“釜底抽薪，看似精妙，实则步步凶险、处处掣肘。一步错，则满盘输。我们如今身在西羌，无兵无权、无援无势，仅有数年蛰伏积累的些许人脉、讯息，想要撼动黑水羌与魏临的勾结根基，绝非易事。”
他俯身，指尖沿着舆图上的山川河道缓缓游走，开始细致拆解全盘计谋，条理清晰、层层递进：“欲抽其薪，必先辨薪、定序。第一步，离间羌部，打破三足平衡，乱其外势。西羌三部，黑水强横、白水庸弱、赤土隐忍，看似对峙平衡，实则矛盾丛生、人心各异。黑水羌常年欺压弱小、劫掠附庸，早已积怨众多，只是其余各部畏其威势、惧其后台，不敢妄动。”
“我们可暗中联络赤土羌王烈戈，投其所好、晓以利害。烈戈野心勃勃，一心想要称霸西羌、取代黑水，却忌惮魏临的朝堂势力，不敢贸然发难。我等可许其重利，告知其只要覆灭黑水羌，中原桎梏自解，西羌无外力干预，便可由其独霸，让他看到可成之功、可图之利，坚定其反水之心。”
“同时，暗中散布流言，挑动黑水与白水两部的猜忌。白水羌王妥罗虽怯懦，却极为惜命、贪利，最怕被黑水羌当作弃子，最终得不偿失、身死族灭。我们可暗中散播消息，称黑水羌早已打算吞并白水草场、人口，只为储备兵力，待冬日过后便会动手，让妥罗心生惊惧，暗中疏离黑水，瓦解二者同盟。”
沈随凝神细听，连连颔首，随即问道：“离间二部，可乱西羌外势，瓦解黑水羌的附庸助力。那第二步，该如何行事？”
陈近仇眸光锐利，语气愈发沉稳：“第二步，断其财路、绝其军械，抽空黑水羌的根本底气。黑水羌之所以能常年强盛、压制诸部，无非两大依仗：一是靠劫掠边境、收受魏临供奉，财用充足；二是靠魏临暗中输送的精良军械，兵甲锐利、战力强悍。财为军之根基，械为战之利刃，财械两绝，黑水羌便是无根之木、无源之水。”
“魏临输送军械、收受财物的密道，我三年来早已探查清楚。其路线隐秘，避开了朝廷戍边关卡，沿祁连山北麓的荒僻古道往来，每月一次，风雨无阻。古道隘口狭窄、地势险峻，易守难攻，正是截杀物资、断绝通道的绝佳之地。”
“我们无需正面截杀大军，只需暗中设伏、毁其通道、烧其辎重，斩断这条财械命脉。每月一次的输送尽数断绝，黑水羌无新械补给、无财物支撑，不出半年，军心必乱、战力必衰，常年征战的精锐之师，终将不战自疲。”
沈随闻言，心中豁然开朗，由衷赞叹：“将军此策，直击要害！不与强敌正面交锋，专断其命脉、耗其根基，着实是釜底抽薪的无上妙策！”
陈近仇神色未松，继续推演后续布局，神色肃然：“这还不够。财械断绝、外势瓦解，只是断其表层薪火，第三步，便是诛其心、毁其援，彻底断绝魏临与西羌的勾结根基，永绝后患。”
“黑水羌与魏临私通数年，往来书信、密约凭证无数，只是尽数被双方隐秘收藏，无人知晓。我等可暗中潜入黑水王庭，盗取密信、搜集实证，将内外勾结、祸乱边疆、劫掠百姓、私通外藩的罪证一一坐实。”
“随后，将罪证一式数份，暗中送往边疆戍边大营、朝堂清流派臣、各州监察御史手中。魏临身居高位，最惜声名、最重权位，最怕私通外寇、祸乱江山的罪公之于众。罪证确凿、天下皆知，朝堂舆论哗然，清流派倾力弹劾，陛下必然震怒。届时，魏临自顾不暇，再无余力扶持黑水羌，甚至会为求自保，主动斩断与西羌的所有关联。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Hidden Dragon Covers Tiger Wei Que Hanyan Chapter 54: Make revenge and draw firepower from the bottom of the cauldron (..la) In the land of Xiqiang, dusk clouds hang over the fields, and the yellow sand rolls three thousand miles.
It's late autumn, the Qilian Mountains are rolling and the vegetation is sparse. The wind blows day and night through the deserted Gobi desert, rolling up fine gravel and hitting the earthen towers of the Qiang village, making a soft rustling sound. The world between heaven and earth is vast and desolate, without half of the warmth and elegance of the autumn scenery of the Central Plains, only the coldness and chill of the wild wilderness.
In Longzhai, the largest settlement of Baishui Qiang, the embers of the bonfire were not extinguished, and the curls of green smoke were torn to pieces by the strong wind. Qiang warriors can be seen everywhere in the village, with short knives hanging on their waists and hard bows on their backs. Their expressions are fierce and unruly, and their eyes hide the wildness and fierceness of nomadic warriors who have been fighting for many years. Inside the tallest watchtower in the heart of the village, the lights are bright and the room is silent, which is completely different from the noisy and rough outside the village.
Chen Jinchou was sitting on a stone couch paved with rough felt. His plain-colored gown had long been worn by the wind and sand outside the Great Wall, the corners were frayed, and it was stained with dust, but he was still tall and straight, with a majestic character. His eyebrows are handsome, but not gentle at all. There is a long-lasting depression and coldness between his eyebrows. His black eyes are as deep as a cold pool. There is no wave at all, only deep hatred and long-planned edge are hidden in the depths.
An oil lamp on the desk flickered and danced, and the dim yellow light flickered on and off, casting his shadow on the mottled earth wall, as lonely and lonely as a cold pine tree on the edge of a cliff. There was no wine or meat on the table, only a roll of yellowed maps spread out flat. The map was densely marked with the various territories of the Western Qiang, mountain passes, pastures and water sources, and several key strongholds were circled with ink pens. The pen was sharp and powerful, and every ink mark was hidden with careful thought.
This place is thousands of miles away from the Central Plains. It is blocked by mountains and is cut off from all communications. It is a wilderness in the eyes of the world, but it is the place where Chen Jinqiu has been dormant for three years and is ready to play chess.
Three years ago, there was a turmoil in the Central Plains court, with powerful and traitors taking over, and those who were loyal and good being framed. The Chen family has been loyal and loyal for generations. They have guarded Western Xinjiang for decades, guarding the border and appeasing the Qiang people. They have never exceeded the rules. However, the traitors in the court were afraid of the Chen family's powerful military power and growing reputation, and even regarded the important ministers on the border as an obstacle to seizing power, so they fabricated unfounded charges of collaborating with the enemy and treason, and confiscated the family and exterminated the family overnight.
There were more than a hundred people in the house, old, weak, women, children, loyal ministers and righteous men, all of them were stained with blood on the execution ground, and no bones were left. Only Chen Jinchou, who was stationed at the pass of Western Xinjiang with his father at that time, was lucky enough to be escorted by his personal guards to the death, and escaped from the rebel army. Since then, he has been reduced to Xiqiang, and has become a desperate man without a country, a home, and hanging outside the Great Wall.
Three years of wandering, three years of forbearance. The high-spirited and sincere enthusiasm of the young general in the past has long been worn away by the wind and frost outside the Great Wall and the blood feud that wiped out his family. What is left is only hatred that is cold to the bones, and the determination to wait for an opportunity to take revenge.
Everyone else said that Chen Jinqiu lived an ignoble existence and shrank away from the world. Only he knew clearly that he had never forgotten the blood debt all over his family. Forbearance is not cowardice, and dormancy is not perdition. He is in the wilderness of Xiqiang, with hatred in the Central Plains in mind, planning day and night, just for one day, the wind blows, overturns the hatred, and comforts the loyal souls of the whole family.
"General, the night wind is blowing hard and the chill is chilling your bones. It's time to add more lights."
There were low and gentle footsteps outside the door, and a man with a calm appearance wearing Qiang cloth pushed the door open and entered with a respectful posture and awe in his eyes. This person's name is Shen Sui, who was the commander of the bodyguards who desperately escorted Chen Jinchou to break out of the encirclement. He has been with Chen Jinchou for three years and has been with him life and death. He is the only trusted and available confidant around Chen Jinchou.
Shen Sui raised his hand to gather his clothes that were ruffled by the wind, and closed the wooden door with his backhand, cutting off the howling wind and the noisy Qiang language outside the house. His eyes fell on the map on the case, looking at the dense markings and circles, and he spoke softly, with a bit of solemnity in his tone: "All the messengers from various ministries have returned. The current situation in Xiqiang is exactly the same as what the general deduced."
Chen JinchouwenHe slowly raised his eyes, his eyes still calm and cold, without any waves, and he only made a faint sound. After three years of wind and sand, his voice was low and hoarse, with a power that penetrated people's hearts: "Tell me one by one, no omissions."
"Yes." Shen Sui bowed in agreement, walked slowly to the case, bowed his head and detailed the situation of each tribe, "Today, among the eight tribes of Western Qiang, the three tribes of Heishui, Baishui and Chitu are the most powerful. The other five tribes are all vassals and dependent, and are weak. King Muye of Heishui Qiang has a violent and greedy temperament. He has been having an affair with Wei Lin, the treacherous prime minister of the Central Plains for a long time. Every autumn and winter, he will send elite cavalry across the border to plunder border villages, plunder food and population, and half of the proceeds will be sent to the Central Plains to worship Wei Lin in exchange for the court's acquiescence and even secret military support. "
"Tuo Luo, the king of the White Water Qiang, is mediocre and cowardly, with no ambitions. He only wants to stick to the grassland and live in a small corner. He has no intention of expansion and hegemony. He always relies on the Black Water Qiang and follows their advancement and retreat, without daring to disobey. Liege, the king of the Red Earth Qiang, is brave, good at fighting and ambitious. Bo Bo, unwilling to be subordinated to others, secretly accumulated troops and gathered a small group, and had a long-standing grudge with the Heishui Qiang. He was just afraid that the Heishui Qiang would get Wei Lin's secret help and become stronger, so he kept silent, and the two faced each other, barely maintaining a balance. "
Shen Sui's story is clear and organized, and he tells the story of the entanglement of forces, popular support and interests among the three tribes of Xiqiang in detail. Every word is precise and every sentence is close to the actual situation. Finally, he raised his eyes to look at Chen Jinchou and added a bit of solemnity to his tone: "The reason why Wei Lin has been conniving and secretly supporting the Heishui Qiang all the year round is not just because he is greedy for money and offerings. His real intention is to use the rebellion of the Western Qiang to contain him. The original frontier force consumes the court's border guards and supplies. When the frontier is exhausted and the troops are empty, they can completely control the military power in the western frontier, collude with internal and external forces, consolidate their own power in the court, and pave the way for usurping power in the future. "
This analysis of the situation accurately hit the core of the collusion between the Central Plains power traitors and the Western Qiang rebels. It was also the fundamental reason why the Chen family was framed and exterminated. In the past, the Chen family guarded the western frontier, strictly guarded against Qiang infestations, put an end to internal and external liaisons, and blocked Wei Lin's ambition to collude with foreign vassals and control the frontier. Therefore, they were regarded as a thorn in the side and a thorn in the flesh, and they were tragically exterminated.
Chen Jinchou's fingertips gently touched the location of the Black Water Qiang Royal Court on the map. The ink lines were cold and biting, just like his mood at the moment. The coldness in his eyes was getting thicker, and the corner of his lips curved up with a very light, but bone-chilling arc, and he spoke slowly: "Wei Lin is very resourceful and well aware of the principle that 'foreign aggression will never end, but internal power will not change'. The rebellion of the Western Qiang is the foundation for his stable power; the strength of the Blackwater Qiang is the fuel for him to contain the borders and control the situation."
"Everyone in the world wants to seek revenge by decapitating their enemies, pacifying their enemies, and killing them with one blow. But Wei Lin has been in the court for many years, and his party members are all over the government and the public. He has a deep foundation. If he only shows his lust for a moment and rashly assassinates and attacks, not only will he not be able to get revenge, but he will scare the enemy and lead to total destruction."
He slowly raised his hand, focused his fingertips on the map, and spoke firmly and sonorously: "Therefore, this enemy cannot be attacked by force, but can only be taken skillfully. If you do not retreat the enemy or kill the general, you must first cut off its roots and eliminate its source. Wei Lin's foundation is in the court, and his support is in the Western Qiang. The Black Water Qiang is a sharp blade he planted on the border, and it is the firewood for him to consolidate power in the border areas."
"When the fire is gone, the sharp blade will break on its own. This plan is to draw fire from the bottom of the cauldron."
A few words revealed the entire plan. After three years of dormancy, three years of observation, and three years of deduction, Chen Jinchou had already seen through this strategic chess game that spanned the Central Plains and Xiqiang. Ordinary revenge seeks to directly kill and kill the enemy; but his revenge seeks to subvert the overall situation and uproot the enemy, causing the enemy to collapse from the foundation, ruining his reputation and losing everything.
When Shen Sui heard the words, his eyes suddenly lit up, and he immediately bowed and saluted, sincerely convinced: "The general has a clever plan, this plan is a surefire kill! Cut off Wei Lin's foreign aid and disrupt the overall situation of the Western Qiang. Without even a single soldier from the Central Plains, he can overthrow the foundation of the enemy and invade the country far away.It is safer and more thorough than a frontal attack! "
Chen Jinchou shook his head slightly, but his expression remained solemn, without any hint of complacency: "Taking fuel from the bottom of the cauldron may seem sophisticated, but in fact it is dangerous and restrictive at every step. One wrong step and the whole game is lost. We are now in Xiqiang, with no troops, no power, no support, and only a few contacts and information accumulated in dormancy for several years. It is not easy to shake the foundation of the collusion between Heishui Qiang and Wei Lin. "
He leaned over and slowly walked his fingertips along the mountains and rivers on the map, and began to dissect the entire strategy in detail, with clear and layer-by-layer structure: "If you want to draw out the salary, you must first identify the salary and sequence it. The first step is to alienate the Qiang tribe, break the three-legged balance, and disrupt its external power. The three tribes of Xiqiang, Black Water is tyrannical, White Water is mediocre, and Chitu is forbearing. They seem to be in conflict and balance, but in fact they are full of contradictions and have different people's hearts. The Black Water Qiang has been oppressing the weak and plundering its vassals for many years, and has already accumulated many grievances. However, the other tribes are afraid of its power and backing and dare not act rashly. "
"We can secretly contact Liege, the king of the Red Earth Qiang, and work with him to find out our interests. Lie Ge was ambitious and wanted to dominate Xiqiang and replace Heishui, but he was afraid of Wei Lin's power in the court and did not dare to attack rashly. We can promise him a lot of profit and tell him that as long as the Heishui Qiang is destroyed, the shackles of the Central Plains will be lifted, and the Xiqiang will be able to dominate without external intervention, let him see the achievements and benefits that can be achieved, and strengthen his determination to rebel against the Qiang. "
“At the same time, rumors were secretly spread to stir up suspicion between Blackwater and Whitewater. Although King Tuoluo of the White Water Qiang is cowardly, he cherishes his life very much and is greedy for profit. He is most afraid of being treated as an abandoned son by the Black Water Qiang. In the end, he will lose more than he gains and his family will be destroyed. We can secretly spread the news that the Blackwater Qiang has long planned to annex the Whitewater pastures and population just to reserve troops, and will take action after winter. This will frighten Tuoluo, secretly alienate the Blackwater, and disintegrate the alliance between the two. "
Shen Sui listened attentively, nodded repeatedly, and then asked: "Separating the two tribes can disrupt the external power of the Western Qiang and disintegrate the vassal support of the Heishui Qiang. So what should we do in the second step? "
Chen Jinchou's eyes were sharp and his tone became calmer: "The second step is to cut off its financial resources, eliminate its weapons, and drain away Heishui Qiang's fundamental confidence. The reason why Heishui Qiang has been able to be strong and suppress other tribes all year round is due to two major reasons: first, it relies on plundering the border and accepting Wei Lin's tribute, so it has sufficient financial resources; second, it relies on the sophisticated ordnance secretly delivered by Wei Lin, which makes its armor sharp and powerful. Wealth is the foundation of an army, and weapons are the sharp edges of war. Wealth and weapons are two of the most important things. Blackwater Qiang is a tree without roots and water without a source. "
"I have already discovered the secret passage through which Wei Lin transports weapons and collects property over the past three years. Its route is secretive, avoiding the imperial border gates, and traveling along the remote ancient road at the northern foot of the Qilian Mountains, once a month, rain or shine. The ancient pass is narrow and the terrain is steep, making it easy to defend but difficult to attack. It is an excellent place to intercept supplies and cut off passages. "
“We don’t need to intercept the army head-on, we only need to set up an ambush secretly, destroy its passages, burn its baggage, and cut off this lifeline of wealth and equipment. The monthly transportation has been cut off, and the Blackwater Qiang has no supply of new weapons or financial support. Within half a year, the morale of the army will be chaotic and the combat effectiveness will decline. The elite divisions that have been fighting all year round will eventually tire themselves out without fighting. "
When Shen Sui heard this, his heart suddenly became enlightened and he sincerely praised: "General, this strategy hits the vital point! Not confronting a powerful enemy head-on, arbitrarily controlling its lifeline and draining its foundation is really the best way to draw out the firepower! "
Chen Jinchou didn't look relieved and continued to deduce the follow-up plan with a solemn expression: "This is not enough. Cutting off wealth and equipment and collapsing external forces only cut off the superficial firepower. The third step is to kill their hearts and destroy their aid, completely cutting off the foundation of collusion between Wei Lin and Xiqiang, and eliminating future troubles forever. "
"Heishui Qiang and Wei Lin had been having an affair for several years, and there were countless letters and secret contracts, but they were all secretly collected by both parties and no one knew about them. We can secretly sneak into the Blackwater Royal Court, steal secret messages, collect evidence, and prove the evidence of internal and external collusion, chaos on the border, plundering the people, and liaison with foreign vassals. "
"Then, and secretly sent the criminal evidence in duplicate to the frontier garrison camp, the Qing Dynasty ministers in the court, and the supervisory censors of various states. Wei Lin was in a high position, he cherished his reputation and power the most, and he was most afraid that his crimes of collaborating with foreign invaders and causing trouble in the country would be made public. The evidence of the crime is conclusive and known to the whole world. The public opinion in the court is in an uproar and the Qing faction is trying their best to impeach him. Your Majesty will definitely be furious. By then, Wei Lin would be too overwhelmed to take care of himself and would no longer have the energy to support the Blackwater Qiang. He would even take the initiative to cut off all ties with the Xiqiang in order to protect himself. "
